verdict.rationale: Retell provides post-call webhooks (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed) and analytics/AI QA scoring for sentiment, success, and custom fields synced to CRM, which covers outcomes and dispositions delivered via webhook. However, evidence doesn't clearly document a structured entity-extraction API/schema per call beyond 'custom fields' mentions, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the structured data payload format. missing for 10: dedicated API endpoint/schema for structured post-call data extraction, documented entity extraction fields, independent verification of webhook payload structure.
